item.title: Riley Green Leads a Night Honoring the ACM’s Lifting Lives With Lauren Alaina, Randy Houser & More: 5 Highlights
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of country music. Tonight, we're shining a spotlight on a very special event that took place in Las Vegas, all in support of a great cause. Let's dive in!"
[Music transitions to a country-inspired tune]
Host: "On Friday night, May 15th, the country music community came together for 'Country on the Green' at TopGolf in Las Vegas. The event was headlined by Riley Green and featured an all-star lineup, including Avery Anna, Lauren Alaina, Rodney Atkins, and Randy Houser. All of these talented artists came together to support Lifting Lives, the Academy of Country Music's philanthropic partner, as it celebrates its 20th anniversary."
[Music transitions to a clip from the concert]
Host: "Lifting Lives has made a significant impact over the years, donating over $12 million to more than 150 causes. The organization provides emergency relief, including support during the COVID-19 pandemic, to those working in the country music industry. They also support a music camp for individuals with Williams Syndrome."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "The event was a huge success, with each of the supporting acts performing four-song sets, and Riley Green wrapping up the evening with a nine-song set. And if you're a country music fan, you won't want to miss the 61st ACM Awards, streaming live on Amazon's Prime Video this Sunday, May 17th, at 8 p.m. ET from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our show. We'll be back soon with more updates from the world of country music. Until then, keep on singing along to your favorite country tunes!"
